关键词云图

美联储加息 长债5% 中关村规划 香港五年规划 控制权变更 算力合同 回购负反馈 概念澄清 科技相对强 期指分化 光通信反弹 双重数据缺口
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
海外
美联储加息后股债同步承压
美联储9月16日把联邦基金目标区间上调25个基点至3.75%-4.00%，为三年多来首次加息；道指跌1.21%、标普500跌0.44%、纳指跌0.01%，10年期美债收益率收于5.003%。高利率继续抬高A/H成长估值门槛。
夜盘
亚洲早盘美股期指反弹，但恒指期货偏弱
截至08:34 CST，公开延迟行情显示，道指、标普500和纳指100期货约涨0.46%、0.45%和0.61%；恒指期货约跌1.36%。反弹暂未逆转高利率压力，A/H开盘仍需本地成交确认。
能源
光通信与AI硬件逆势反弹，科技防御接棒
9月16日Lumentum约涨9.6%、Coherent约涨6.9%；08:52新快照中计算机硬件涨1.63%，英伟达持仓概念涨3.76%、COHR领涨6.92%。事实支持光通信/AI基础设施相对走强，但不等于A/H开盘可直接追涨。
政策
北京发布中关村世界领先科技园区“十五五”规划
北京市9月16日发布规划，明确人工智能、集成电路、6G、具身智能、量子科技、商业航天、新材料等方向，并提出到2030年基本建成世界领先科技园区。政策利好需由订单、资本开支和价格反馈验证。
政策
北京现代服务业扩能提质方案实施
北京市政府9月16日发布2026-2030年方案，落实国务院服务业扩能提质部署。科技服务、金融与生产性服务业获得中期制度支持，但不是单家公司利润承诺。
香港
香港首个五年规划聚焦创科、金融与北部都会区
香港特区政府9月16日公布首个五年规划及施政报告，提出AI补贴、前沿科技专班、黄金中央结算、北部都会区产业园和定向税务优惠。方向清晰，具体受益仍取决于预算、落地名单与成交验证。
控制权
经纬股份拟引入中软国际系控股股东并复牌
中软国际（西安）智能科技拟以53元/股受让经纬股份29.68%股份；标的停牌前9月9日收盘37.50元，9月17日复牌。协议溢价显著，但控制权交割、审批与复牌波动风险并存。
AI算力
赛意信息算力服务合同金额上调至67.2亿元
公司把一份合同含税金额由36亿元调至38.7亿元，两份合同合计由64.5亿元增至67.2亿元，核心期限和交付排期不变。订单线索积极，但客户履约、采购融资与利润转化仍须核验。
回购
三一重工大额回购未能抵消负面价格反馈
9月16日公司回购1662.06万股、支付约2.99亿元，累计回购约3.33亿元；当日股价仍收于18.18元、下跌6.72%。回购是支持因素，但明显负反馈不能包装成多头确认。
风险
北自科技澄清电子布织布机仍处生产验证阶段
公司股票连续两个交易日涨幅偏离值累计超过20%，同时公告其电子布织布机处于生产验证阶段，不涉及电子布生产和销售。概念热度领先于商业化证据，列为回避。
芯片
恒玄科技首次回购规模仍小于既有减持压力
9月16日首次回购5万股、支付466.98万元，成交92.21-94.94元；既有5%以上股东及一致行动人减持计划约占总股本1.50%。实际回购是新增事实，但尚不足以消除供给压力。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
加息冲击后期指温和反弹
9月16日道指、标普500和纳指分别跌1.21%、0.44%和0.01%；08:34 CST道指、标普500和纳指100期指约涨0.46%、0.45%和0.61%。10年期美债收益率5.003%与WTI约101.48美元仍是关键闸门。
板块对照
新排行由硬件、防务与储能接棒，负榜仍有缺口
行业前五转为医药零售、航空航天与国防、电气设备、奢侈品和计算机硬件，概念前五为英伟达持仓、加密矿企、太空、室温超导和储能；这是对硬件、防务与储能强势的确认。行业后五抓取超时，代表股运行时夜盘逐项报价不可得，暂不能判定背离或潜在反转，也不能据此断言全面风险偏好。
A/H映射
光模块、商业航天与储能进入重点观察，不等于追涨
光通信映射中际旭创、长飞光纤等；防务/太空映射商业航天链；电气设备与储能映射电网设备和储能链。医药零售、奢侈品、加密矿企和室温超导缺少足够直接或可验证的A/H候选，本轮明确无新增个股卡。A/H开盘报价未可靠取得，所有映射等待价格与成交验证。

盘前结论

事实：08:52美股排行已更新，行业前五转向医药零售、军工、电气设备、奢侈品和计算机硬件；概念端英伟达持仓、加密矿企、太空、室温超导和储能居前。Lumentum约涨9.6%、Coherent约涨6.9%，确认光通信/AI硬件反弹。

判断：光通信、商业航天和储能的A/H映射优先级上升，但5%长债收益率继续压制估值；因开盘报价缺口，本轮维持原5张条件关注/回避卡，不新增追涨推荐。

不确定性：行业后五因超时缺失，AKShare仍是9月16日盘中partial快照，A/H今日开盘价格未能可靠取得；新方向须等待价格、成交与本地公告确认。

重点个股关注

状态说明：卡片是条件研究或回避状态，不是即时买入指令。

经纬股份SZ.301390
条件关注

事实与状态：中软西安拟以53元/股受让29.68%股份；最近可靠行情为停牌前9月9日收盘37.50元。当前尚未开市，不能把协议价当作可成交买点。

确认条件：复牌后不出现失控式高开回落，控制权协议与审批继续推进，成交量能承接溢价预期。

风险与失效：交易失败、审批或交割延误、复牌剧烈回撤；若高开后快速跌破开盘区间则失效。

赛意信息SZ.300687
条件关注

事实与状态：两份算力服务合同总额上调至67.2亿元；截至08:34 CST未取得可交叉验证的9月16日收盘价，报价缺口不删除业务事件卡。

确认条件：开盘后取得可靠报价，价格不出现明显负反馈，且公司披露客户履约、采购资金及毛利兑现路径。

风险与失效：客户集中、融资与服务器采购压力、执行或回款不及预期；价格显著弱于算力板块则降级。

北自科技SH.603082
回避

事实与状态：连续两日异常波动后，公司明确电子布织布机仍在生产验证且不生产、不销售电子布；截至08:34 CST未取得可靠最新收盘价。

确认条件：只有商业化订单、收入贡献和价格消化异常波动均被验证后才重评。

风险与失效：概念炒作回落、验证失败或订单不落地；当前信息不足以支持多头卡。

三一重工SH.600031
回避

事实与状态：9月16日回购约2.99亿元，但股票收于18.18元、跌6.72%，明显负面价格反馈优先于回购标题。

确认条件：价格止跌并重新强于工程机械板块，且后续回购与经营数据形成一致支持后再观察。

风险与失效：高油价和资本开支波动、回购不能对冲抛压；继续破位则维持回避。

恒玄科技SH.688608
回避

事实与状态：9月16日首次回购5万股、成交92.21-94.94元；既有股东减持计划规模明显更大，最新收盘价未获独立可靠确认。

确认条件：持续回购、减持压力被成交吸收且股价重新强于芯片板块后再评估。

风险与失效：激励用途不等同注销，供给压力与高利率估值压制仍在；弱于行业则维持回避。

板块轮动看板

相对受益

光通信/CPO、AI硬件、商业航天、军工、电气设备与储能；只作方向观察，等待A/H价格确认。

事件观察

经纬控制权变更、赛意算力合同上调、恒玄实际回购；原条件卡保持不变。

压力方向

5%长债收益率下的高估值长久期资产，以及缺少本地证据的加密、超导和奢侈品映射。

验证信号

中际旭创/长飞光纤等光通信链、商业航天与储能链的A/H价格和成交；行业后五恢复情况及开盘宽度。

逻辑链

利率约束

美联储加息 → 10年期美债升至5.003% → A/H高估值成长面临折现率压力。

硬件轮动

光通信、计算机硬件与英伟达持仓概念走强 → CPO/AI硬件映射升温 → A/H价格与成交决定是否兑现。

主题分化

军工、太空、电气设备和储能居前 → 商业航天/电网储能进入观察 → 加密、奢侈品、超导因映射不足不新增候选。

负反馈优先

回购或概念标题 → 三一大跌、北自商业化澄清 → 明确回避而非包装多头。

风险雷达

利率

5%长债收益率可能继续压缩估值。

复牌与交割

经纬协议溢价不等于可成交收益，复牌波动和审批风险高。

合同兑现

大额算力合同面临客户、采购资金、履约和利润率风险。

概念退潮

商业化证据不足的异常波动标的可能快速回撤。

数据新鲜度

AKShare仍为9月16日盘中partial快照；美股排行已更新至9月16日时段，但行业后五和A/H今日开盘报价缺失，均已明确披露。

数据来源与时间点

更新于2026-09-17 10:24 CST；来源截点10:24 CST。核心来源：美联储及Reuters/WSJ 9月16日收盘报道；Moomoo GitHub Actions快照于08:52抓取9月16日美股时段排行，行业状态partial、仅前五，概念状态ok、前五完整；Barron's与MarketWatch 9月16日报道交叉确认Lumentum约涨9.6%—11%、Coherent约涨6.9%—7.9%的光通信/AI基础设施反弹。AKShare仍为2026-09-16 12:50 CST的partial盘中快照；云端动态报价端点被客户端拦截且搜索未取得可交叉验证的9月17日A/H开盘报价，因此不新增个股卡。行情可能延迟。

PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 shows importance, not returns.
Major News
Global
Fed hike leaves both stocks and bonds under pressure
The Fed raised its target range by 25bp to 3.75%-4.00% on Sep 16, its first hike in more than three years. The Dow fell 1.21%, the S&P 500 0.44% and the Nasdaq 0.01%, while the 10-year Treasury yield closed at 5.003%. The higher discount rate remains a valuation headwind for A/H growth stocks.
Futures
US futures rebound in Asia while Hang Seng futures lag
At 08:34 CST, delayed public quotes showed Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 futures up about 0.46%, 0.45% and 0.61%, while Hang Seng futures were down about 1.36%. The bounce has not removed the rate shock; local opening flow remains decisive.
Energy
Optical and AI hardware rebound as technology defense takes over
Lumentum rose about 9.6% and Coherent about 6.9% on Sep 16. The 08:52 snapshot put computer hardware up 1.63% and the NVIDIA portfolio concept up 3.76%, led by COHR at +6.92%. This confirms relative strength in optical/AI infrastructure, not a direct A/H opening chase.
Policy
Beijing publishes the Zhongguancun 15th Five-Year Plan
Released Sep 16, the plan highlights AI, semiconductors, 6G, embodied intelligence, quantum technology, commercial space and advanced materials, targeting a world-leading science park by 2030. Orders, capex and price confirmation still matter.
Policy
Beijing launches its 2026-2030 modern-services plan
The municipal government published its service-sector expansion and quality plan on Sep 16, implementing the State Council framework. It offers medium-term support to technology, financial and producer services, but is not a company-level earnings guarantee.
Hong Kong
Hong Kong's first five-year plan targets innovation, finance and the Northern Metropolis
The Sep 16 Policy Address and five-year plan include an AI subsidy, frontier-technology task force, central gold clearing, Northern Metropolis industry parks and targeted tax incentives. Beneficiaries still require budget, implementation and trading confirmation.
Control
Jingwei plans a ChinaSoft-linked controlling shareholder and resumes trading
ChinaSoft International (Xi'an) Intelligent Technology plans to acquire 29.68% at RMB53 per share. Jingwei last closed at RMB37.50 on Sep 9 and resumes Sep 17. The premium is material, but closing, approvals and reopening volatility remain risks.
AI compute
SAIYI raises two compute-service contracts to RMB6.72bn
One contract rises from RMB3.6bn to RMB3.87bn, taking the two-contract total from RMB6.45bn to RMB6.72bn, with term and delivery schedule unchanged. The order signal is positive; execution, procurement funding and margin conversion remain unverified.
Buyback
Sany's large buyback did not offset negative price action
Sany repurchased 16.62m shares for about RMB299m on Sep 16, taking cumulative spending to about RMB333m, yet the stock closed at RMB18.18, down 6.72%. The buyback is supportive, but the price rejection cannot be presented as bullish confirmation.
Risk
North Automation says electronic-cloth loom remains in validation
The stock's two-day closing-price deviation exceeded 20%, while the company said its electronic-cloth loom is still in production validation and it neither produces nor sells electronic cloth. Theme momentum is ahead of commercialization evidence; status is avoid.
Chip
Bestechnic's first buyback remains smaller than the existing sale overhang
The company bought back 50,000 shares for RMB4.67m at RMB92.21-94.94 on Sep 16. An existing plan by a 5%-plus shareholder and concert parties covers about 1.50% of shares, so the new execution does not yet remove supply risk.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight index
Futures rebound modestly after the rate-hike shock
The Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq fell 1.21%, 0.44% and 0.01% on Sep 16. At 08:34 CST, Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 futures were up about 0.46%, 0.45% and 0.61%. The 5.003% 10-year yield and WTI near $101.48 remain the main gates.
Sector contrast
Hardware, defense and storage take over; the negative table is still missing
The industry top five rotated to pharmaceutical retail, aerospace and defense, electrical equipment, luxury goods and computer hardware, while concepts were led by NVIDIA holdings, crypto mining, space, room-temperature superconductors and storage; this confirms the hardware, defense and storage leadership. Runtime overnight quotes for each representative ticker were unavailable and the industry bottom five timed out, so divergence or a potential reversal cannot yet be determined and broad risk appetite cannot be inferred.
A/H mapping
Optics, commercial space and storage move to watch, not chase
Optical links map to names such as Eoptolink and Yangtze Optical Fibre; defense/space maps to the commercial-space chain; electrical equipment and storage map to grid and storage suppliers. Pharmaceutical retail, luxury, crypto mining and superconductors lack sufficiently direct, verifiable A/H candidates, so no stock card is added. Reliable A/H opening quotes were unavailable; all mappings await price and volume confirmation.

Pre-market Conclusion

Fact: the 08:52 US ranking rotated to pharmaceutical retail, aerospace and defense, electrical equipment, luxury goods and computer hardware. NVIDIA holdings, crypto mining, space, room-temperature superconductors and storage led concepts. Lumentum rose about 9.6% and Coherent about 6.9%, confirming the optical/AI-hardware rebound.

View: A/H optical, commercial-space and storage mappings now rank higher, but the 5% long yield still constrains valuations. Because opening quotes could not be verified, the existing five conditional-watch/avoid cards remain and no chase candidate is added.

Uncertainty: the industry bottom five timed out, AKShare remains a Sep 16 partial intraday snapshot, and today's A/H opening prices were unavailable. New themes require price, volume and local-disclosure confirmation.

Stock Focus

Status note: Cards are conditional research or avoid states, not immediate buy instructions.

JingweiSZ.301390
Conditional watch

Facts and status: ChinaSoft Xi'an plans to acquire 29.68% at RMB53 per share. The latest reliable quote is the pre-suspension Sep 9 close of RMB37.50. The deal price is not an executable entry.

Confirmation: After resumption, the stock avoids an uncontrolled gap-and-fade, while the agreement and approvals continue to progress.

Risks and invalidation: Deal failure, approval or closing delays, or a sharp reopening reversal; a fast break below the opening range invalidates.

SAIYISZ.300687
Conditional watch

Facts and status: Two compute-service contracts were raised to RMB6.72bn. No independently cross-checked Sep 16 close was available by 08:34 CST; the quote gap does not erase the business event.

Confirmation: A reliable post-open quote shows no material negative feedback and disclosures clarify customer performance, procurement funding and margin conversion.

Risks and invalidation: Customer concentration, financing and server-procurement pressure, execution or collection delays; material underperformance versus compute peers downgrades the case.

North AutomationSH.603082
Avoid

Facts and status: After two abnormal trading days, the company said its electronic-cloth loom remains in production validation and it neither produces nor sells electronic cloth. A reliable latest close was unavailable by 08:34 CST.

Confirmation: Reassess only after commercialization orders, revenue contribution and digestion of the abnormal move are verified.

Risks and invalidation: Theme unwind, failed validation or missing orders; current evidence does not support a bullish card.

Sany Heavy IndustrySH.600031
Avoid

Facts and status: The company repurchased about RMB299m on Sep 16, but shares closed at RMB18.18, down 6.72%. The material negative price feedback outweighs the headline.

Confirmation: Price stabilizes and regains relative strength versus machinery peers, with further buybacks and operating data aligned.

Risks and invalidation: Oil and capex volatility, plus buybacks failing to absorb supply; further breakdown keeps the avoid status.
